context:
Goal: one uniform direction for every watch, wake, sweep, reap and log, in place of the patchwork of lessons, bugs and fixes (your note on item 180, 06:50 CST).
Problem (rule): rule outcomes-mechanize-rules says no timer, no long-lived process, a stated cost and a test that proves it. Main breaks this in three places. The stall watcher keeps a python process and a 0.2 s loop per background job, while its record says "no new process or timer". ci_wake polls for up to 55 min per `gh pr ready`. The daily job is a timer. About 25 mechanisms state no cost, and none has a cost test.
Based on (read): the load brake (decision machine-load-brake) already states its cost and proves it in a test. It is the model to copy.
Based on (read): the critic found that only the stall watcher wakes a session that sits idle on a silent background job. The Stop check fires only at a turn end.
Departs from: main — adds one Cost, Reader and Test line to each mechanism record, a shared cost-test helper, and a check-records rule that fails a record without them. It names three standing exceptions in place of silent breaks.

Source: Sonnet workflow align-watchers (3 mappers, a synthesis and a critic), 06:58 CST; it found 30 mechanisms plus about 12 hooks. Meanwhile, two lanes that need no ruling run: watchers-stall-defects (stall temp files, repeated stall message) and watchers-prose-and-plan (docs/plans/align-watchers.md, stale prose). Sub-questions: 248 sits beside this item in one group and is still open. 249 (pick b, Nov 4) and 250 (pick a, closed) are answered.

lastAnswer.note: send a sonnet workflow to align all of these toward one uniform direction as its currently a patchwork of lessons bugs and fixes and stale prose

options.gain: One rule everywhere; each break becomes visible and tested; no idle job goes unwatched.
options.how: Run only inside a hook already started. The stall watcher, ci_wake and the daily job stay as named exceptions, each with a stated cost and a cost test.
options.label: Events only, with three named exceptions
options.lose: Three processes remain; about 8 small lanes of cost lines and tests.

options.gain: The rule holds with no exception.
options.how: Drop the stall watcher, and replace ci_wake with a PR subscription locally too.
options.label: Events only, no exceptions
options.lose: A job that stalls while the session is idle is never reported, and agents wait blind.

options.label: Leave it as is
options.lose: The patchwork stays; records keep claiming costs the code does not have.

title: Which one rule should every watch, wake, sweep, reap and log follow?
why: Recommended: a. One rule covers every mechanism, and the three that break it become named, costed and tested instead of silent.
